metadata.title: FAQ — Kayaking & Water Sports in Aswan
metadata.description: Answers to common questions about safety, swimming, group size, pricing, cancellation policy and opening hours for Duck Entertainment's Nile kayaking trips in Aswan.

faq.a1:
Yes. All our activities are designed to be completely safe.
We provide certified life jackets, a full briefing before you start, and continuous support from our team during the trip.
faq.q2: Do I need to know how to swim?
faq.a2:
No, it is not required.
The life jacket keeps you safe even if you are not a strong swimmer.
faq.a3:
Trip length depends on the package you choose; you can pick a duration that suits you when booking.
Our base package includes a kayak, life jacket, and paddle.
faq.a4: The maximum weight is 130 kg per participant.
faq.a5:
The activity is suitable for:
• Individuals
• Friends
• Families
• Tourists
faq.a6: Yes. Children must be accompanied by an adult. Requirements may vary depending on the type of activity.
faq.a7:
We recommend:
• Comfortable clothes
• Shorts or sportswear
• Light shoes or sandals
faq.a8: Yes, but we recommend a waterproof bag or leaving it somewhere safe.
faq.a10:
You can book easily through our website.
For groups and corporate offers, please contact us directly.
faq.a11:
Yes. Our cancellation and refund policy is:
• Free cancellation up to 24 hours before the activity (full refund)
• Cancellation less than 24 hours before the activity: no refund
• No-show: no refund
• Bad weather or circumstances beyond our control: Duck may reschedule the activity, or offer a full refund if rescheduling is not possible
• Late arrival: we wait for a limited time according to the operating schedule; if the activity cannot go ahead, it is treated as a no-show
faq.a12:
We operate daily from sunrise to sunset.
Best times to visit: in winter, any time of day; in summer, sunrise and sunset are ideal.

faq.transportDescription: We can arrange transport to and from the activity location for an additional fee. Message us on WhatsApp for details and pricing.

metadata.title: About Us | DUCK
metadata.description: DUCK is an Egyptian platform specializing in booking and managing water-based recreational activities across Egypt, starting in Aswan.

about.heroDescription: DUCK is an Egyptian platform specializing in booking and managing water-based recreational activities. We bring together trusted activity providers in one place, making it easy to discover, book, and enjoy unforgettable experiences. Starting in Aswan, DUCK is expanding across Egypt to connect adventure seekers with kayaking, water biking, stand-up paddleboarding (SUP), sailing, and more—ensuring a seamless journey from booking to the end of every adventure.
about.visionBody: To become Egypt's leading and most trusted platform for booking and managing water activities, driving the future of recreational tourism through safe, seamless, and technology-driven experiences.
about.missionBody: Our mission is to make water adventures more accessible and enjoyable by connecting people with trusted providers through a modern digital platform while maintaining the highest standards of quality, safety, and customer service.
about.value1Body: Customer safety comes first. We work with trusted providers who meet high safety standards to ensure every adventure is secure.
about.value2Body: We believe in protecting our waterways and promoting eco-friendly experiences that preserve the Nile and Egypt's natural environment.
about.value3Body: Every experience is carefully designed to create memorable moments with exceptional service from start to finish.
about.value4Body: We value transparency, reliability, service quality, and a smooth booking experience.
about.value5Body: We leverage technology to simplify booking and enhance the way people discover and enjoy water activities.
about.goal1: Become Egypt's leading platform for water activity bookings.
about.goal2: Build the country's largest network of trusted activity providers.
about.goal3: Deliver a fast, seamless, and secure digital booking experience.
about.goal4: Support both domestic and international tourism.
about.goal5: Expand across Egypt's top tourism destinations.
about.goal6: Raise quality and safety standards across the water recreation industry.
about.why3: A wide range of experiences for everyone.
about.why4: Transparent pricing with no hidden fees.
about.why5: Customer support before, during, and after your trip.
about.why6: Everything you need in one platform.
about.promiseBody: At DUCK, we don't just book water activities—we create unforgettable experiences that begin the moment you book and stay with you long after your adventure ends.
